name: Qube Browser 0.1.17-alpha
notes:
Splitscreen, settled

This release is about the split feeling right.

- Dragging the divider is far smoother. The divider, the bars and the outline
  follow your pointer exactly, without stutter.
- Leaving a split no longer leaves you on a black page.
- After a restart, the split remembers which half you were working in.
- The outline around your working half sits exactly on the page's edge.

Known

- While you drag the divider, the page itself refills a moment behind your
  pointer, most noticeably on heavy pages.
- You still cannot make a split by dragging a tab onto the page, nor by
  Alt-clicking a link. Right-click a tab and choose Split Right.
- A split restored from a previous session appears once you click either half.
- In Mac style, hovering the green dot does not open Windows' snap-layout
  menu. Windows style keeps it.
- A download does not yet say which site it came from.
- An extension popup still takes about a second to appear.
summary: Splitscreen, settled: dragging the divider is far smoother, leaving a split works cleanly, and the split remembers which half you were in.
